### What is PDRN?

Polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) consists of microscopic DNA fragments originally used in regenerative medicine to heal wounds. Applied topically, it signals skin cells to ramp up collagen production, calm inflammation, and repair a compromised moisture barrier.[[1]](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/best-pdrn-serum)[[2]](https://www.boots.com/inspire-me/skincare-advice/routines/what-is-pdrn)[[3]](https://www.allure.com/story/best-pdrn-serums)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g)

2. Apply 1 to 2 pumps of the serum directly to your face and neck.[[1]](https://uk.theinkeylist.com/products/pdrn-serum)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:9774223470536245636,catalogid:15941048620442189641,gpcid:14993077774578537749,mid:576462823592462797&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6182669727972116745,catalogid:6773575022961355835,gpcid:12797384870457311317&ibp=oshop)
